facts.fact: JMERC's October 2026 call says Lesotho's district education officers collect, validate and transmit school data into the national EMIS, which uses DHIS2 for education data.
JMERC's October 2026 call refers to the Eswatini ministry's termly DHIS2-based EMIS tool used by school EMIS focal persons and regional officers.
